info.title: NOALBS Cloud API
info.description: API behind the NOALBS Cloud dashboard.

get.summary: List the add-ons, with their prices per unit.

post.summary: Create an add-on. Its Stripe product is made when its first price is set.

put.summary:
Edit an add-on. A lower maximum applies to changes from now on; nobody loses
what they have.

delete.summary: Remove an add-on nobody pays for. Its Stripe product and prices are archived.

get.summary: What staff did, newest first: Admin actions and support work in workspaces.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: `admin` or `support`; both when left out.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many entries (default 50, up to 200).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only entries before this time, for paging back.

get.summary: List the shared NOALBS bots.

delete.summary: Disconnect a shared bot. Channels without a workspace bot go quiet.

Unlink a chat channel from every switcher, in every workspace: the bot
leaves it. Its owner can link it again.

get.summary: Every notice, newest first.

post.summary: Post a notice.

put.summary: Change a notice.

delete.summary: Delete a notice.

post.summary: Stop showing a notice now. One that hasn't started is deleted.

get.summary: List every organization.

post.summary: Create an organization. Add its first admin with an invite.

get.summary: An organization with its team and client workspaces.

put.summary:
Rename an organization and change its limits. The switcher pool can't go
below the switchers its clients already have (409 `limit_below_usage`): a limit
never stops a running switcher.

delete.summary: Delete an organization that has no client workspaces left.

get.summary:
A page of an organization's client workspaces, searched and filtered like its own
team sees them (without their live state).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text (name, slug or ID).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based.

oneOf.description: Whether a customer joined a client.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: What the client is doing now; reads every client's live state.

oneOf.description: What a client is doing now (what the dot in the list shows).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Newest first when left out.

oneOf.description: How the clients are ordered.

post.summary:
Invite someone to an organization's team, e.g. its first admin. The link is
`/org-invite/{token}`, shown once.

put.summary:
Suspend an organization: every client's switchers pause and their chat goes
quiet, and the team and customers see the reason. Again with another reason
updates it.

delete.summary: Lift an organization's suspension.

get.summary: Numbers at a glance.

post.summary: Create a plan. Its Stripe product is made when its first price is set.

put.summary: Edit a plan. Its limits apply to every workspace on it right away.

delete.summary:
Remove a plan nobody is on and nobody pays for. Its Stripe product and
prices are archived.

get.summary: Every plan and add-on, offered or not, with prices and subscriber counts.

put.summary:
Set what new subscribers pay for a plan or add-on at a billing period. The
previous price is archived; subscriptions on it keep it.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: `plan` or `addon`

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: `month` or `year`

delete.summary:
Stop selling a plan or add-on at a billing period. Subscriptions on the
price keep it.

post.summary:
Sell a plan or add-on at an existing Stripe price (e.g. one made in the
Stripe Dashboard). The previous price is archived here, not in Stripe.

get.summary: What's running now: switchers, the chat service, Twitch, Kick and YouTube.

post.summary:
Close a switcher's browser-source connection so it reconnects, e.g. when
it's stuck. Nothing changes for the streamer beyond a second's reconnect.

get.summary: Users, newest first unless sorted by activity.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text (a username or ID).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based.

oneOf.description: How recently the listed users were active (used a session or signed in).

get.summary: One user: sign-ins and workspaces.

put.summary:
Disable a user: they're signed out and can't sign in. Not for staff (remove
their staff access first) or yourself.

delete.summary: Let a disabled user sign in again.
Sign a user out everywhere, e.g. after their account was compromised.

put.summary: Grant or remove staff access. You can't remove your own.

get.summary: Workspaces, newest first.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text (name, slug or ID).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Only the client workspaces of this organization (workspaces list).

get.summary: One workspace: members, switchers and billing.

post.summary:
Staff: open a workspace without its permission, for abuse, a legal
obligation or a security problem. For an hour, to look or to act on switchers
(`level`); the workspace's owners and admins see who, what and why until
they acknowledge it.

put.summary:
Set a workspace's plan directly (a comp). Meant for workspaces without a
subscription: the next Stripe event for one recomputes its plan.

Suspend a workspace: its switchers pause, its chat links go quiet, and its
members see the reason. Again with another reason updates it.

delete.summary: Lift a workspace's suspension.

post.summary:
Sign in without OAuth. Only available when the API runs with
`dev_login = true`; answers 404 otherwise.
Sign out and clear the session cookie.

get.summary: Get the signed-in user.
List the available sign-in methods.
Look up an invite link.

post.summary: Accept an invite and join its workspace.

delete.summary:
Delete your account for good (GDPR erasure). Workspaces you own alone go with
it (a subscription ends at once, without a refund). If a workspace you own has
other members, transfer it, remove them or delete it first: 409 `owns_shared_workspace`.

Disconnect a linked account. Browsers that signed in with it are signed out,
except this one. The last account can't be removed: you couldn't sign in.

get.summary: Download everything NOALBS Cloud keeps about you, as JSON.

Download the stream history of your own switchers (see `DataExport`), one
JSON object per line: an `about` line, then each `stream`, `stats` bucket
and activity log `event`, as stored.

put.summary: Remember the workspace the user opened, so they return to it next time.

get.summary:
Your switchers that are connected now, from every workspace you are a member of, live
ones first, with totals over all of them. Read from the status bucket, so it is current
to a few seconds.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a client's or switcher's name, or a client's URL.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Every connected switcher when left out.

oneOf.description: Which connected switchers the overview lists.

get.summary: List where you're signed in, most recently used first.

post.summary: Sign out every browser except this one.

delete.summary: Sign out another browser. Use `POST /auth/logout` for this one.

get.summary:
The workspaces you are a member of, a page at a time, with whether they are live.
Filtering by what they are doing reads every matching workspace's switchers.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the name or URL.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Only where you have this role.

oneOf.description: A role a member has in a workspace.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: What the workspace is doing now; reads the live state of every matching workspace.

oneOf.description: What a client is doing now (what the dot in the list shows).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Oldest first when left out.

oneOf.description: How the clients are ordered.

get.summary: The notices in force now, oldest first.
Look up a team invite link.

post.summary: Accept a team invite and join the organization's team.

get.summary: List the organizations the current user is on the team of.

An organization by its URL slug, for the dashboard's `/orgs/{slug}` pages.
Only its team can see it; anyone else gets 404.
Get an organization.

The activity across all the organization's clients, newest first: what
happened on each switcher and who did it (the team, a customer, chat or the
automatic switcher). Admins only.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Only this client workspace.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a client's or switcher's name, or a client's URL.

parameters.name: kinds
parameters.description: Only these kinds of event, comma separated (e.g. `stream_started,stream_stopped`).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only events before this time, for paging back.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many events (default 50, up to 200).

get.summary:
What the team, the customers and NOALBS changed in the organization, newest
first. Admins only.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only entries before this time, for paging back.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many (default 50, up to 200).

get.summary: List an organization's chat bots, which speak for all its client workspaces.

delete.summary: Disconnect an organization's bot; its clients' channels get the shared bot.

get.summary: List a page of an organization's client workspaces, with whether they are live.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text (name, slug or ID).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based.

oneOf.description: Whether a customer joined a client.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: What the client is doing now; reads every client's live state.

oneOf.description: What a client is doing now (what the dot in the list shows).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Newest first when left out.

oneOf.description: How the clients are ordered.

post.summary:
Create a client workspace. It has no owner (the organization is) and no plan
(the organization's limits apply); invite the customer with an `admin`
invite from `/workspaces/{id}/invites` when they should get in.

put.summary: Set the switcher allocation of many clients at once.

post.summary:
Create many client workspaces from a list of names. Each URL follows its name
(with a number added when it is taken); a name that fails doesn't stop the rest.
Delete many client workspaces and everything in them.

Make a customer invite link (role admin) for each of the clients. Like the single
Invite button, for the whole team: whoever runs the clients hands them over.

put.summary:
Rename a client or change its switcher allocation, which can't go below the
switchers it already has (409 `limit_below_usage`).

delete.summary:
Delete a client workspace and everything in it (its switchers and their
history, its customers' membership).

get.summary: List an organization's open team invites.

post.summary: Create an invite link for someone joining the team.

delete.summary: Revoke an open team invite.

get.summary:
The organization's switchers that are connected now, live ones first, with
totals over all of them. Read from the status bucket, so it is current to a few
seconds.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a client's or switcher's name, or a client's URL.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Every connected switcher when left out.

oneOf.description: Which connected switchers the overview lists.

get.summary: List an organization's team.

delete.summary:
Remove a team member, or leave the team when `user_id` is yourself. The last
admin can't go.

put.summary:
Change what the organization decides itself: whether its customers may connect
a chat bot of their own.

get.summary: List the plans a workspace can be on, with their prices.
List the workspaces the current user is a member of (staff see all).

post.summary: Create a workspace owned by the current user.

403.description: `workspace_limit`: you own the most workspaces allowed

get.summary:
A workspace by its URL slug, for the dashboard's `/{slug}` pages: a member
gets it with their role; staff get any workspace (role `null`) with what
support may do there (`support_access`).
Check whether a workspace URL can be used.
Get a workspace.

delete.summary:
Delete a workspace and everything in it: its switchers and their history,
members and invites. A subscription ends at once, without a refund. Owner only.

put.summary:
Set how many of an add-on the workspace has. More is charged now for the
rest of the period; fewer (or 0) applies when the period ends.

402.description: `payment_failed` (the charge was declined) or `no_payment_method`; nothing changed

409.description: No subscription yet, or it is ending

post.summary: Start paying: returns a Stripe Checkout page to send the browser to.

409.description: Already subscribed; change the subscription instead

put.summary:
Switch between monthly and yearly billing for everything, now: unused time
is credited and the new period charged.

402.description: `payment_failed` (the charge was declined) or `no_payment_method`; nothing changed

409.description: No subscription, or it is ending

put.summary:
Move to another plan on an existing subscription. A paid plan is charged
now for the rest of the period; `free` applies when the period ends (add-ons
stay).

402.description: `payment_failed` (the charge was declined) or `no_payment_method`; nothing changed

409.description: No subscription yet (use Checkout), or it is ending

post.summary: The card, invoices and cancelling everything, in Stripe's portal.
Undo a cancellation before the period ends.

get.summary: Get the workspace's chat bots and the shared ones.

delete.summary: Disconnect the workspace's own bot; the shared bot speaks again.

get.summary: List a workspace's open invites.

post.summary: Create an invite link. Only the owner can invite admins.

delete.summary: Revoke an open invite.

get.summary: List the members of a workspace.

delete.summary: Remove a member, or leave the workspace when `user_id` is yourself.

get.summary: Get a workspace's plan, how much of it is used, and its subscription.
Whether NOALBS support may come into the workspace now.

put.summary: Let NOALBS support in for a while, replacing the permission in force.

delete.summary: End NOALBS support's permission now (not break-glass access, which lasts an hour).

post.summary: Mark every emergency access as seen, which hides its banner.

get.summary:
What NOALBS staff did in the workspace, newest first. Looking around is
listed once an hour per page; every change is listed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many entries (default 50, up to 200).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only entries before this time, for paging back.

get.summary: List a workspace's switchers.

post.summary: Create a switcher. Returns its browser-source URL, which is shown only once.

get.summary: Get a switcher and its settings.

delete.summary: Delete a switcher and its stream servers.

put.summary: Turn automatic switching on or off. Operators may do this mid-stream.
Replace the switcher's behaviour settings.

Connect a BELABOX through BELABOX Cloud (or disconnect it), and whether it
starts and stops with the OBS stream.

Set the BELABOX's max bitrate: at once while it streams, otherwise from its next
start from here, chat or the OBS stream.

get.summary:
What the BELABOX settings dialog shows: WiFi adapters with their networks and hotspot,
modems with their APN settings, audio inputs and codecs, pipelines, relays and the
stream settings. Passwords and the stream ID are never returned (`has_…`). The dialog
polls this while it's open: obs-link answers from what the BELABOX reported.

put.summary:
Names for the BELABOX's network interfaces, saved by interface key. Replaces the
names saved before.
Turn one of the BELABOX's network interfaces (`usb0`, `wlan0`, …) on or off.

Change a modem's APN, roaming, network type and operator (`switcher.manage`). The BELABOX
takes the modem's connection down to apply them, so a stream over it stutters.

post.summary:
Search for mobile operators. The modem goes offline while it scans (about a minute), so
do it before a stream. The results show up in the details.

put.summary:
Stream settings, used from the BELABOX's next start from here (the dashboard, chat or the
OBS stream): BELABOX only saves them when it starts, so nothing reaches it before that.
Refused while it streams.

post.summary:
Start (`active: true`) or stop the BELABOX stream. Starting uses the settings
last saved on the BELABOX.
Join a saved WiFi network. How it went shows in the details' `result` a few seconds later.
Leave the WiFi network the BELABOX is connected to (it stays saved).

Join and save a new WiFi network (`switcher.manage`). The password is write-only.
How it went (`auth` = wrong password) shows in the details' `result` within 15 seconds.

delete.summary: Forget a saved WiFi network (`switcher.manage`).

post.summary: Search for WiFi networks again; the results show up in the details a few seconds later.

put.summary: Turn a WiFi adapter into a hotspot (`active: true`) or back into a WiFi client.

404.description: `unknown_wifi` (no such adapter, or it can't be a hotspot)

put.summary:
Rename the hotspot, change its password or band (`switcher.manage`; it must be running).
The BELABOX restarts it; how that went shows in the details' `result`.

404.description: `unknown_wifi` (no such adapter, or it isn't a hotspot now)

get.summary: Get a switcher's chat settings and commands.

post.summary: Add another name for a command, e.g. `!b` for `!bitrate`.

delete.summary: Remove an alias.

put.summary:
Change how a channel works for this switcher (other switchers using it keep
their own settings).

delete.summary: Remove a channel from this switcher. Other switchers using it keep it.

put.summary: Turn a command on or off and set who may use it.

post.summary:
Ignore a chatter's commands on this switcher. The name is looked up on the
platform, so they stay ignored if they rename.

delete.summary: Stop ignoring a chatter.

put.summary: Replace a switcher's chat settings.

post.summary:
Replace the connect token. The old browser-source URL stops working. Not for
NOALBS support: the link gets the OBS password from obs-link.

get.summary: The activity feed, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many events (default 50, up to 200).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only events before this time, for paging back.

get.summary: Live status, stats and activity for a switcher, as server-sent events.
get.description:
- `status`: a `SwitcherStatus`, or `null` while no browser source is connected.
  Sent first, then on every change.
- `belabox`: a `BelaboxStatus`, or `null` while no BELABOX link runs (no remote
  key, or no browser source). Sent second, then on every change (about once a
  second while the BELABOX is online).
- `moblin`: a `MoblinStatus`, or `null` while no Moblin is connected. Sent
  third, then on every change.
- `stats`: a `StatsSample` per second; the last two minutes are replayed first.
- `event`: a `SwitcherEvent` as it happens.

post.summary: Add a marker to the running stream.

put.summary:
Connect Moblin's remote control (or disconnect it), and whether Moblin starts
and stops with the OBS stream. A new or removed password disconnects the
Moblin connected now.
Use one of Moblin's bitrate presets.

get.summary:
The Assistant URL and password to enter in Moblin (the password is a
secret: only for members who manage the switcher, never NOALBS support).

put.summary:
Turn Moblin's connection priorities on or off. Off, Moblin uses every
connection alike (the connections' on/off and priorities don't apply).

Turn one of Moblin's bonding connections (Cellular, WiFi, a Moblink relay, …)
on or off, or set its priority. Applies while connection priorities are on.

post.summary: Mute or unmute Moblin's microphone.
Start (`active: true`) or stop recording on the phone.

put.summary: Switch Moblin's scene.

post.summary:
Stealth mode: Moblin's screen shows a black (or custom) image instead of the
camera. The stream isn't affected.
Go live (`active: true`) or stop, on Moblin.
Turn the phone's light on or off.

put.summary: Zoom Moblin's camera.
Use one of the current camera's zoom presets.
Set how the browser source reaches obs-websocket on the streamer's machine.

get.summary: The inputs on OBS's Audio Mixer for the scene on air, with their mute state.

Audio levels and mute/fader changes for the mixer, as server-sent `audio`
events (an `AudioUpdate` each). OBS sends levels only while someone keeps
one of these open (they cost the streamer's upload), about 5 a second;
inputs missing from a `levels` update are silent.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: `false`: only mute and fader changes, without asking OBS for levels.

post.summary: Mute or unmute an input on OBS's Audio Mixer.

put.summary:
Move an input's fader on OBS's Audio Mixer. Not logged in the activity
feed: dragging sends many.

post.summary:
Fix the feed like `!fix`: the network media sources playing on the scene on
air (nested scenes and groups included) reconnect. Unfreezes a feed stuck
after a drop.
Start (`active: true`) or stop recording.
Switch OBS to a scene.

get.summary: The scenes in the switcher's OBS.

A JPEG still of the scene on air, for the Live page's preview. Each one is
sent by the streamer's OBS computer, so the dashboard asks at the rate the
viewer picked; a frame from the last quarter second is shared between viewers.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width in pixels (160 to 1280, default 640); the height keeps the aspect ratio.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: JPEG quality, 1 (smallest) to 100 (best); default 60.

post.summary: Show or hide a source, like `!source`.

get.summary: Everything on the scene on air, nested scenes and groups included.

OBS's stats right now: frame rate, dropped frames by cause, CPU, memory and
disk, plus the stream output's byte count for a bitrate between two readings.

post.summary: Start (`active: true`) or stop the stream.

put.summary: Replace which OBS scene is used for each role.

get.summary: List a switcher's stream servers in priority order.

post.summary: Add a stream server at the end of the priority order.

403.description: `plan_limit` when the switcher has its plan's number of stream servers

put.summary: Set the order stream servers are tried in.

post.summary: Fetch a stats URL once and report what came back, before or after saving it.

400.description: A missing or invalid kind-specific field

delete.summary: Remove a stream server.

patch.summary: Change a stream server's name, address or whether it is used.

put.summary: Replace a stream server's scene overrides.

get.summary: The switcher's streams, newest first (only those the plan still keeps).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many streams (default 20, up to 100).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only streams that started before this time, for paging back.

get.summary: One stream: its stats per server over `from`..`to` and its activity.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range to zoom into (default: the stream's start).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range (default: the stream's end, or now).

delete.summary: Delete a stream from the history.

get.summary: A stream's markers, in order.

One server's raw stats during a stream, as the server reported them. Only
for managers: raw stats can hold stream names or the publisher's address
(not NOALBS support).

put.summary: Replace the switcher's triggers.

post.summary:
Make another member the owner; the current owner becomes an admin. With
Stripe billing, the workspace's cards, billing email, address and tax IDs are
removed first (a subscription keeps running until its period ends; the new
owner adds a card to renew it), and if that fails nothing changes.

disabled_at.description: Set by staff: the account can't sign in.

connections.description: The Twitch, Kick and YouTube accounts you sign in with.

organization_audit.description: What you did in organizations, from their audit logs.

sessions.description: Browsers signed in to your account.

staff_actions.description: What NOALBS staff did about your account (or, as staff, did yourself).

staff_work.description: Only for NOALBS staff: their support work and what they set up.

support_grants.description: NOALBS support access you gave (or, as staff, opened).

workspaces.description:
Workspaces you're in or created. Switchers are listed for your own (see
`switchers`), billing for those you own.

device.description: The adapter's ID, from the details.

password.description: 8–63 characters; leave out for an open network.

AddonDto.description: An add-on that can be bought per unit, on top of (or without) a plan.

status.description:
`available` only when it can be bought (it has a price); a hidden one is
listed so workspaces that have it can still lower it.

unit.description: What one unit is called, e.g. `slot`.
What one unit is called, e.g. `slot`.

AddonVisibility.description: Whether an add-on shows on the Plan page and can be bought.

removal_blocked_by.description: Why it can't be removed; `null` when it can (nothing depends on it).

status.description: As set here; the Plan page shows `available` without a price as coming soon.

AdminAuditEntryDto.description:
Something staff did: from Admin (`kind` `admin`, `action` a code like
`suspend_workspace`) or inside a workspace as support (`kind` `support`,
`action` the API route, with `method`).

oneOf.description: Support: the permission it was done under, and whether break-glass.

reason.description: Why, for staff (and the user, when they ask): 10–500 characters.

grandfathered.description: On a price that is no longer sold (grandfathered).

oneOf.description: What its price costs per unit, if the price is known.

AdminNoticeDto.description: A notice as staff see it.

created_by_name.description: Who posted it, as they were named then.

AdminOrganizationRefDto.description: An organization, named where something belongs to it.

reason.description: Shown to the organization's team: 10–500 characters.

addons.description: Units of each add-on billed on live subscriptions.

mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue (yearly prices ÷ 12), per currency.

stripe_test_mode.description: Whether the Stripe key is a test-mode key.

archived_prices.description: Earlier prices, still paid by the subscriptions on them.

custom_chat_bot.description: Workspaces on it may connect their own chat bot.

prices.description: What new subscribers pay (at most one per interval).

removal_blocked_by.description: Why it can't be removed; `null` when it can (nothing depends on it).

subscribers.description: Workspaces with a live subscription for it.

workspaces.description: Workspaces on this plan (paying or comped).

currency.description: The currency prices use (Checkout can't mix currencies in one subscription).

connected.description:
Switchers with their browser source connected: live ones first (longest-running
first), then those with OBS connected.

switchers_error.description: Set when obs-link's status bucket couldn't be read.

reason.description: Shown to the workspace's members: 10–500 characters.

links.description: How many switchers it was linked to.

disabled_at.description: Disabled by staff (no sign-in): when and why; `null` otherwise.

username.description: From the most recently used sign-in.

chat_channels.description:
Chat channels linked to its switchers, with every link they have
(other workspaces' too).

oneOf.description:
What NOALBS support may do in it now: its own permission, else
break-glass; `null` = nothing (opening it asks for permission).
The organization this is a client workspace of.

stripe_customer_url.description: The Stripe customer in the Stripe Dashboard.

subscription_status.description: The live subscription's status, if it has one.

suspended_at.description: Suspended by staff: when and why; `null` otherwise.

oneOf.description: The inputs that made a sound since the last levels; the rest are silent.

actor_name.description: As they were called then; NOALBS for staff.

details.description: Extra facts about it (what changed, how many), by action.

subject.description: What it was about, e.g. a client's or member's name.

auto_switch_notification.description: Post in chat when a scene switches.

bitrate_switcher_enabled.description: Switch scenes automatically using the triggers.

ending_timeout.description:
Stop the stream after this many minutes on the Ending scene (1–1440);
`null` = never.

instantly_switch_on_recover.description: Go back to LIVE as soon as the feed recovers.

offline_timeout.description:
Stop the stream after this many minutes on the BRB scene with no feed
(1–1440); `null` = never.

only_switch_when_streaming.description: Leave OBS alone while it isn't streaming.

recording_scene_ids.description:
Keep recording on these OBS scenes; pause it on every other scene.
An empty list disables scene-based recording control.

retry_attempts.description: How many bad checks in a row before switching away from LIVE.

it streaming), so OBS stats can count this stream's dropped frames like
NOALBS. `null` while not streaming, and while paused (no switcher runs).

SwitcherSummaryDto.description: A switcher as listed in its workspace.

last_seen_at.description: When a browser source last connected; `null` if it never has.

paused.description:
Over the plan's switcher limit after a downgrade: it doesn't switch and
can't be controlled until the workspace upgrades or deletes another switcher.

oneOf.description: Live status; `null` while no browser source is connected.

TeamInviteDto.description: A team invite that can still be used. The token is only shown once.

TeamInvitePreviewDto.description: What someone opening a team invite link sees.

already_member.description: Whether the current user is on the team already.

TeamMemberDto.description: A team member and the profile of their most recently used login.

provider.description: The login the profile comes from, e.g. `TWITCH`.

details.description: The settings as typed. Secrets left out come from `stream_server_id`.

stream_server_id.description: The saved server being edited, for its stored secrets.

user_id.description: The member who becomes the owner.

TriggersDto.description: Bitrate (kbps) and RTT (ms) thresholds. `null` turns a trigger off.

low.description: Switch to the LOW scene at or below this bitrate.

offline.description: Switch to the offline (BRB) scene at or below this bitrate.

rtt.description: Switch to the LOW scene at or above this round-trip time.

rtt_offline.description: Switch to the offline scene at or above this round-trip time.

conduit_subscriptions_by_type.description: Those delivered through our conduit, by type.

recorded.description: What the chat service recorded having made.

subscriptions_by_status.description: All of the app's EventSub subscriptions, by status (`enabled`, or why not).

total_cost.description: Cost against Twitch's limit (subscriptions nobody authorised cost 1).

oneOf.description: Replaces the kind-specific settings; secrets left out are kept.
For workspaces you own.

managed_by.description: The organization that manages this client workspace, if it is one.

plan.description: Not for a client workspace: the organization's limits apply.

role.description: `None` when you created it but are no longer a member.

switchers.description:
For your own workspaces: those you own, or an organization manages for
you. Other workspaces' switchers belong to their owners.

billed.description:
How many are billed from the next invoice on (less than `quantity` after
lowering it, until `held_until`).

quantity.description: How many it may use now.

WorkspaceChatBotsDto.description: Who speaks for a workspace in chat.

custom_allowed.description: Whether the plan lets the workspace connect its own bot.

organization.description:
A client workspace's organization's bots, which speak where the workspace
has none of its own (empty for other workspaces).

own.description: The workspace's own bots. They speak only while `custom_allowed`.

shared.description: The shared NOALBS bots, which speak where nobody else's does.

WorkspaceDto.description: A workspace and the current user's role in it.

oneOf.description:
For a client workspace: the organization that owns, manages and pays for it
(its team can see everything here). `null` for an ordinary workspace.
The current user's role in that organization, when they are on its team.
The current user's role; `null` for staff who aren't a member.

For staff who aren't a member: what NOALBS support may do here now
(`null` = nothing, so the dashboard asks for permission). Always `null`
for members.
Suspended by NOALBS: switchers paused and chat quiet; `null` otherwise.

switcher_allocation.description: A client workspace's switcher allocation (`null` = only the organization's pool).

billing_enabled.description: Whether plans can be bought here (Stripe is configured).

can_manage_billing.description: Whether you may subscribe or manage billing (`billing.manage`).

needs_payment_method.description:
The subscription will renew but there's no card: an ownership transfer
removed the previous owner's and the new owner hasn't added one yet.

WorkspaceRole.description: A role a member has in a workspace.

YouTubeLastError.description: The last error YouTube answered with.

quota.description: The app's daily quota is used up (it resets at midnight Pacific time).

oneOf.description: The last error YouTube answered with (kept a day).

The instance following the live chats, as it last said (every 10 s);
`null` if none has yet.

YouTubeWatcherSummary.description: The instance following YouTube's live chats, as it last said.

chats_open.description: Of those, the ones whose live chat is being followed.

streaming.description: Linked YouTube channels with a switcher streaming.
